fixed.how: Commit fa6a725 (from the fixup run cut off by the restart; kept as is). registry/tools.ts isFileName decides what counts as a file. The ending must be a file's (FILE_EXTENSIONS: md, csv, json, html, js and the like; not NET, IO or com). The word must also not be a TECHNOLOGY: a capitalised one-word name with .js or .ts, or a well-known lower-case one. A path such as src/App.js is still a file. Every other dotted word loses its dots before fileTheWordsWrite reads the clause, so it is never the file and never ends the clause. FILE ends at a word boundary and allows endings of up to 8 characters. When in doubt the plain line shows, and the plain line is true whatever the words ask for. Docs: ADR 0109's amendment now uses the spec's labels (D-5 is the line, D-3 is Edit's words), plus runtime.md and the user guide.

fixed.problem: Review non-blocking item (L4-selftasks-120). Since the redirect guards judge a note by who wrote it, a move said in chat with words for the next attempt became the failed task's card answer, and the note was dropped unsaid. Example: 'try the digest page again and tell it to use the old layout'. The card's own Try again reads 'Tries again with your note, if any; it runs at your next Start.', so the read-back implied the words were kept. Bench, before the fix (walkC-part1.json, step 12): the read-back had no note.
fixed.failing_test_before: packages/commands/test/selftasks-carried.test.ts 'the redirect guards judge a note by who wrote it': the model's-note case (the read-back lacked 'Note for its next brief: ...'), the restart case (the answer was 'Try again' and not { choice, note }), and 'request.answer's note parameter tells the model what to pass' (no such parameter). apps/ui/test/real-daemon.test.ts 'fixup-l4-selftasks-carried: chat's Try again on a failed task's card carries the note the model passed, ...' (the read-back had no note; I reverted the src files and checked fail-first).
fixed.how: The cardWords port's choices carry `input`, and compose maps the Inbox choice's input ('note' for Try again and Send it back). moveAsCardAnswer passes the move's note to request.answer when the chosen option takes one. request.answer has a new optional `note`, with ANSWER_NOTE_DESCRIPTION as the exact text the model receives. Its ask ends 'Note for its next brief: "..."' so the Yes covers the note, and its run answers the card { choice, note } as the Inbox does. syncSignoffAnswers' answerNote then queues the note for the task's next brief. That is the existing queued-note channel, quoted as data in the brief; the injection suite's brief channel covers it, and it stays 92/92. An option that takes no note (Mark done anyway, Cancel task) answers with the option alone and its read-back names no note; this sibling case passed before and after. Docs: ADR 0119 amended 2026-11-24, commands.md, runtime.md, user guide.
fixed.check_in_the_app: Bench (on the final code): start with --env FORERUNNER_BENCH_FAIL=digest --env FORERUNNER_BENCH_FAIL_MODE=error. Add the task 'Write the digest page' and Start a session; it fails and its card '"Write the digest page" failed' offers Try again, Mark done anyway and Cancel task. In Chat type: tool: task_transition {"task":"Write the digest page","to":"ready","note":"Use the old layout."}. The read-back is 'Try again ("Write the digest page" failed)? Tries again with your note, if any; it runs at your next Start. Note for its next brief: "Use the old layout."'. Restart Forerunner: the same read-back waits. Press Yes: 'Trying "Write the digest page" again: it runs at your next Start.'. The card is answered { choice: Try again, note: Use the old layout. } and the task is ready (walkC2-ask.json, walkC2-yes.json; steps 13-15). live_check (this corrects the fixer's steps for L4-selftasks-120): use a medium-risk failed-task card, which a run that failed with an error files ('"X" failed: ...'). The ladder's '"X" failed N times' card is high risk; there chat answers 'Answer it on its card in the Inbox: ...' by design. On the real model, with such a card open, say 'try the digest page again and tell it to use the old layout'. The read-back ends with 'Note for its next brief: "..."' quoting those words. After Yes, the next session's brief for that task has the note.

notes_for_other_areas: request.answer takes an optional `note`. The model is told ANSWER_NOTE_DESCRIPTION: 'Only with an option that takes a note (Try again, Send it back): words the person gave for the next attempt, quoted as they said them; leave it out when they gave none.' The note is kept only when the chosen option's card words say input 'note'; then the ask ends 'Note for its next brief: "..."' and the card is answered { choice, note }, which answerNote reads.

CommandPorts.cardWords choices now carry `input?: 'note' | 'text' | null`, mapped in compose from the Inbox choice's input. moveAsCardAnswer(ctx, { task, project?, note? }, option) passes the note to request.answer when the option takes one.

Executor: confirm() tells onClosed in a finally, so it fires even if perform throws after the card was taken out. expirePending calls onExpired before onClosed, and compose's onExpired no longer emits inbox: rely on onClosed's inbox.changed for every close, a lapse included.
UI polling: the poller's inbox.changed has `openCards` (sorted open request ids, polling only). store/context.tsx treats a changed set as moved even at the same count.
